CSIRO Mouse Surveillance

Spring-2022 Seasonal Summary

Published

April 24, 2026

Overview

This report summarizes house mouse monitoring activities conducted during the Spring-2022 season across Australian grain-growing regions. Mouse abundance was assessed using three complementary survey methods: live-trapping at benchmark sites, and rapid assessments using chew cards and active burrow counts.

Live-trap Surveys: A total of 1,325 trap nights (1 trap night = 1 trap set for 1 night) were conducted across 5 benchmark sites in 3 regions spanning 2 states (survey period: September 2022 to September 2022). These surveys captured 30 individual house mice, allowing abundance estimates at these monitoring locations.

Rapid Assessment Surveys: Rapid assessments were conducted across 10 regions using two methods. Chew card surveys deployed 867 cards across 64 sites, with 14.9% showing evidence of mouse activity (129 cards chewed). Active burrow surveys searched 237 transects across 57 sites (survey period: September 2022 to December 2022), detecting active burrows in 2.1% of transects (total: 6 active burrows).
